title: "Generate combined CVD metrics"
description: "Step 4: calculate and stage hospital-recorded and mortality-linked CVD statistics."

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Step 4 calculates the private CVD event statistics needed in each data release. It uses the Step 3 count dataset for hospital-recorded statistics. It also links the Step 2 confidential event data to a selected classified mortality data release to calculate death-certificate-only (DCO) additions.

It creates private calculated datasets and review evidence. It does not apply final disclosure control, approve the results or publish them.

::: {.callout-tip title="Procedure at a glance" appearance="simple"}
1. Confirm the CVD event and mortality data releases to use together.
2. Run Step 4 from the Stata command window or BNR menu.
3. Confirm `STEP 4: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY` reports `Completed successfully` and the intended release pair.
4. Review the source-quarantine and DCO-linkage totals; open the detailed private evidence when review is required.
5. Check the two staged datasets and three review files before preparing Step 5.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Steps 1–3 for the CVD event data release.
- Complete mortality Steps 1 and 2 for the selected mortality data release.
- The mortality data release cannot be earlier than the CVD event data release.
- Leave replacement off for a first run. Replacement rebuilds the calculations and requires a fresh Step 5 review and approval.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

| File | Purpose and required check |
|---|---|
| `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/metric_inputs/bnr_cvd_input_count_YYYYMM_v01.dta` | Step 3 input for hospital-recorded counts, distributions and rates. Confirm the CVD event data release. |
| `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/metric_inputs/bnr_cvd_input_count_YYYYMM_v01.yml` | Matching Step 3 run record. Confirm the source and row count. |
| `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/bnr_cvd_confidential_YYYYMM_v01.dta` | Confidential event-level data used automatically by the linkage controllers. |
| `$BNR_DATA_DERIVED/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/review/bnr_cvd_step2_quarantine_summary_YYYYMM.csv` | One-row Step 2 quarantine summary carried into the Step 5 review evidence. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/raw/redcap/mortality/yYYYY/mMM/bnr_mort_s1_YYYYMM.dta` | Private mortality identity data used automatically for deterministic linkage. Confirm the selected mortality data release. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/derived/mortality/yYYYY/mMM/bnr_mort_s2_YYYYMM.dta` | Classified mortality data used automatically to select CVD deaths for linkage. |
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | Purpose and use |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do` | Main controller. Runs the ordered linkage, estimation, burden calculation and staging steps. Run directly or through the dialog. |
| `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_cvd_burden.do` | Called automatically to calculate the hospital-recorded burden dataset. |
| `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_step4_stage_expanded_cvd.do` | Called automatically to place the calculated datasets and review components in one private package. |
| `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_cvd_create_dco_review_report.do` | Called automatically to create the private linkage-review workbook, dataset and non-identifying summary. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_step4_metrics.dlg` | Collects the event period, mortality period and replacement choice when Step 4 is run from the menu. |

The complete ordered linkage and estimation code map is in [CVD event–death linkage rules](../../reference/cvd-event-death-linkage-rules.qmd).
:::

## Run Step 4

In the Stata command window, enter the CVD event year and month first, followed by the mortality year and month:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do" 2026 1 2026 7
```

Only for an authorised rebuild, enter:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do" 2026 1 2026 7 replace
```

Alternatively:

1. Choose **User > BNR > Update CVD events dashboard > Step 4: Calculate metrics for dashboards**.
2. Enter the CVD event data-release year and month.
3. Enter the classified mortality data-release year and month.
4. Leave the replacement option unticked for a first run. Tick it only for an authorised rebuild.
5. Select **Run Step 4**.

Both routes run the same Step 4 controller.

## Check successful completion

1. Find `STEP 4: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY` at the end of the Stata output.
2. Confirm `Completed successfully` and the intended CVD event and mortality data releases.
3. Check that the burden-row and rate/count-row totals are plausible.
4. Check the source-quarantine status and count. If it is not clear, return to the Step 2 quarantine workbook.
5. Check the number of DCO records reported for review. When review is required, open the detailed private workbook under the linkage `review/` folder. Its `Needs review` sheet explains why each record was selected. Correct an authoritative source record and rerun when needed; notes entered in the workbook are not source corrections.
6. Confirm that the private staging package contains the two calculated datasets and three review files listed below.

Step 4 follows the implemented deterministic linkage and aggregate estimation rules. It does not ask the reviewer to choose a match manually. Unresolved cases remain unresolved and are handled only by the approved aggregate estimator.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

**Detailed private linkage folder:** `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/derived/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/linkage/mort_yYYYY_mMM/`

| File | Purpose and access |
|---|---|
| `review/cvd_dco_linkage_review_cvd_YYYY_MM_mort_YYYY_MM.xlsx` | **Open this first when DCO linkage review is reported.** Identifiable private workbook with guidance, summary, review cases and deterministic additional-DCO candidates. |
| `review/cvd_dco_linkage_review_cvd_YYYY_MM_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Detailed machine-readable private linkage worklist. |
| `review/cvd_dco_linkage_review_summary_cvd_YYYY_MM_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Non-identifying aggregate linkage-review summary; Step 4 copies it into the staging package with the shorter event-release name below. |
| `stage4_incidence_rates_cvd_YYYY_MM_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Detailed private incidence-rate and DCO calculation result. |
| `stage4_incidence_rate_components_cvd_YYYY_MM_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Private components supporting the calculated rates and later review. |

**Private staging folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/`

| File | Purpose and access |
|---|---|
| `datasets/cvd_burden_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Staged private hospital-recorded burden dataset used by Step 5. |
| `datasets/cvd_incidence_rates_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Staged private mortality-linked counts and rates used by Step 5. |
| `review/cvd_incidence_rate_components_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Staged private rate components used by Step 5. |
| `review/cvd_dco_linkage_review_summary_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Staged non-identifying linkage-review summary used by Step 5. |
| `review/cvd_source_quarantine_summary_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Staged copy of the Step 2 quarantine summary used by Step 5. |

The linkage controllers also create private intermediate checks and logs under the detailed linkage folder and `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`. Keep all Step 4 files private.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 4 does not complete"}
Step 4 should complete routinely when the selected event and mortality inputs are complete and compatible.

| Situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| The selected mortality data release precedes the event data release | Select a mortality data release that is the same month or later, then rerun. |
| A required Step 2, Step 3 or mortality file is missing | Complete and check the relevant earlier workflow step. Do not substitute a file from another data release. |
| Linkage review shows conflicting or unusual identity data | Correct the authoritative mortality or REDCap record where appropriate, then rerun the affected source workflow and Step 4. Do not change the generated worklist or assign a match manually. |
| A staged output already exists | Confirm that a full rebuild and fresh Step 5 review are intended before using the complete `replace` command or dialog option. |

For other uncommon problems, see [Fix common problems](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).
:::
